checkpoint.description: First preserved professional-career checkpoint after completing the GO PRO transition sequence; saved during/after the Professional Division Package notification sequence.

private_artifact.policy: Hashes only. Savestate and extracted RAM remain outside Git.

visible_text: YOU ARE NOW A PROFESSIONAL BOXER.
professional_transition_screen.significance: Retail explicitly presents going pro as a career-mode transition that unlocks additional management/customization systems and pays a $10,000 transition bonus.

fight_store_unlock.name: PROFESSIONAL DIVISION PACKAGE
fight_store_unlock.visible_text: CONGRATULATIONS! YOU'VE UNLOCKED THE PROFESSIONAL DIVISION PACKAGE IN THE FIGHT STORE.

record_model_transition.evidence: The field reset exactly when Career Central changed from amateur 10-0-0 to professional 0-0-0.
The field reset exactly when the professional record became 0 KO.

This counter had mirrored wins throughout the amateur career, increments again across the successful GO PRO transition, but does not reset when the newly displayed professional record resets to 0-0-0.

This counter similarly preserves/increments the pre-professional KO history while the visible professional KO counter resets to zero. The transition result is therefore consistent with a win booked as a KO/TKO in the pre-pro/overall record path.

money_model_transition.evidence: This field ignored the prior $4,000 Fight Store spend, then increased by exactly the same $11,558 inflow as bank during the GO PRO transition. At checkpoint 16 it exceeds bank by exactly $4,000, the amount previously spent. This strongly matches accumulated earnings/inflow before expenditures; a future Sign Contract EARNINGS readout can confirm the exact UI binding.
The purchase-sensitive field resets on professional transition, so it is not a lifetime store-spending total. A phase/career-stage purchase or expense accumulator is now more plausible.

transition_payout_arithmetic.interpretation: The non-bonus portion of the bank increase is $1,558, exactly $1,640 less 5% ($82). This is strongly consistent with the same 5% promoter expense seen in prior amateur contracts.

rank_and_progression_candidates.evidence: The post-transition value 48 is exactly one less than visible rank 49. Amateur values do not yet establish the sentinel/encoding, so zero-based-rank semantics are not named as confirmed until a professional rank change is observed.
A second persistent byte also becomes 48 at the first professional checkpoint. The next visible rank movement should distinguish the two candidates.

The field first changed 0->1 at the amateur-title/Amateur Championship Package milestone and now 1->2 exactly at the professional/Professional Division Package milestone. This strongly ties it to career progression/unlock tiering without yet proving exact semantics.

equipment_persistence.meaning: The equipment-sensitive block created by the trunks/mouthguard/foul-protector purchase remains byte-for-byte unchanged across the professional transition, showing the equipped gear state persists into the pro career.

training_confounds_checkpoint_15_to_16.note: Checkpoint 15 -> 16 is not a pure transition-only experiment because training/fight preparation occurred before the GO PRO fight. The base training block changed and those deltas must not be attributed to professional status itself.

overhaul_implications: Retail maintains a distinct professional record that resets to 0-0-0 when the player enters the professional division while separate counters preserve the completed amateur/transition history.
Professional status unlocks trainers/cutmen, weight-class movement, entrance customization, a $10,000 bonus, and a new Fight Store package in one explicit progression transition.
Purchased/equipped amateur gear survives the transition intact.
The money model cleanly separates spendable bank from an accumulated-earnings-like field once store purchases have occurred.
next_capture: Open Sign Contract once in the professional career and screenshot the top EARNINGS/BANK line. If EARNINGS is $27,353 while BANK is $23,353, that directly confirms 0x08D98578 as the displayed accumulated-earnings value.

Capture the first normal professional contract before signing, especially opponent rank, promised rank change, purse split, promoter/trainer/cutman percentages, rounds, and any future-contract fields.

After the first professional fight, take one stable post-fight savestate. The first rank movement is the highest-value test for 0x08D9851A and 0x08D98538, and the first pro win will determine whether 0x08D98508/0x08D9850B are true whole-career totals or specifically amateur/transition totals.
Avoid spending or changing equipment before that first post-pro-fight checkpoint unless a purchase experiment is intentionally being run.
